create_chrf_scorer: create a ChrFScorer instance to compute character n-gram F-score for translation evaluation
add_string_ref_pred: add a reference and prediction string pair to the ChrFScorer for scoring
score_chrf: score accumulated reference and prediction pairs using character n-gram F-score with order 4
result_string_chrf: get the formatted chrF result object from sacrebleu corpus_chrf for the scorer
review_chrf_scorer_class: review the ChrFScorer class that extends BaseScorer and uses sacrebleu for chrF scoring
